queries.compiledQueryString: select distinct vencimento, dte from arbcripto.opcoes where dte > 5 order by dte
queries.inputQueryString: select distinct vencimento, dte from arbcripto.opcoes where dte > 5 order by dte

queries.compiledQueryString:
select log_moneyness, mark_iv, vencimento
from arbcripto.opcoes
where vencimento in ${inputs.v.value}
  and ((tipo = 'P' and strike <= F) or (tipo = 'C' and strike > F))
  and abs(log_moneyness) < 0.6
order by vencimento, log_moneyness
queries.inputQueryString:
select log_moneyness, mark_iv, vencimento
from arbcripto.opcoes
where vencimento in ${inputs.v.value}
  and ((tipo = 'P' and strike <= F) or (tipo = 'C' and strike > F))
  and abs(log_moneyness) < 0.6
order by vencimento, log_moneyness

queries.compiledQueryString:
select strike, tipo, sum(open_interest) as open_interest
from arbcripto.opcoes where vencimento in ${inputs.v.value} group by strike, tipo order by strike
queries.inputQueryString:
select strike, tipo, sum(open_interest) as open_interest
from arbcripto.opcoes where vencimento in ${inputs.v.value} group by strike, tipo order by strike
